title: Liberty Falls AH129 Pastor George Kendell's Parsonage Americana 1997 Mini House
conditionDescription: A few small paint chips along the roof edges, ridge and porch roof edge showing white resin. Small white mark on felt bottom. No breaks or missing pieces.
descriptionText:
Liberty Falls Americana Collection AH129 "Pastor George Kendell's Parsonage" - a hand-painted resin miniature village house by International Resourcing Services, Inc., dated 1997. White clapboard parsonage with green trim, a shingled roof and brick chimney, a covered front porch, and a garden setting with a brick walk, arbor gate, bench and birdbath. Green felt bottom with the original gold AH129 label.
Measures about 3 1/2 inches across the base (see the photo with the tape measure). Works with other Liberty Falls pieces or any small tabletop or Christmas village.
Condition: Pre-owned display piece. Paint is bright overall, with a few small chips showing white resin along the roof edges and ridge line and on the front porch roof edge (see close-up photos). A small white mark on the felt bottom. No breaks or missing pieces. Please review all photos - they are of the actual piece you will receive.
